AccountOwnershipType4Code/GOVO: Account owner is a government organization.
AccountOwnershipType4Code/NFPO: Account owner is an association that is given tax-free status due to the nature of their activities such as charity organization.
AccountOwnershipType4Code/ONIS: Account owner is another type of non individual organization.
AccountOwnershipType4Code/PART: Account owner is a contractual business organization in which two or more individuals agree to pool their funds to manage and operate a business.
AccountOwnershipType4Code/TRUS: Account owner is an organization which is engaged as a trustee for individuals or businesses in the administration of services such as stock transfer, registration, trust funds.
CardType1Code/DBIT: Card enabling the holder to have its purchases directly charged to its account. The card may also combine other functions, for example, cash card or check guaranteed card.
CertificateType2Code/DFOR: Certification of due formation and organization.
ClosedStatusReason1Code/CLIN: Account is closed, following an instruction from the client, or an authorized party, to close the account.
CRSStatus1Code/C112: Account holder type is an active non-financial entity such as an international organization.
GDPRDataConsent1Code/DP00: Consent to authorize the controller of personal data processing to process personal data for marketing purposes.
GDPRDataConsent1Code/DP01: Consent to authorize the controller of personal data processing to transfer personal data to other companies belonging to the same group for independent processing for marketing purposes.
GDPRDataConsent1Code/DP02: Consent to authorize the controller of personal data processing to transfer personal data to third party companies for independent processing for marketing purposes.
GDPRDataConsent1Code/DP03: Consent to authorize the controller of personal data processing to process personal data for profiling purposes in order to formulate customised and targeted product and service offers.
InvestmentFundRole6Code/FTAG: Financial institution that receives the payment transaction from the account owner, or other authorized party, and processes the instruction.
InvestmentFundRole6Code/INVS: Party, either an individual or organization, whose assets are being invested.
InvestmentFundRole7Code/INVS: Party, either an individual or organization, whose assets are being invested.
MoneyLaunderingCheck1Code/AUTH: Money laundering identification procedures have not been carried out because the investor is an authorized credit or financial institution.
MoneyLaunderingCheck1Code/POEP: Limited money laundering identification procedures have been carried out because it is a one time only transaction and the payment is being made by postal, telephone or electronic transfers from an existing account with an authorized credit or financial institution.
PartyRole1Code/INVS: Party, either an individual or organization, whose assets are being invested.
PendingOpeningStatusReason1Code/ATHP: Authorization is provided but account opening is still pending.
PendingStatusReason1Code/ATHP: Authorization is provided but the account change is still pending.
RejectedStatusReason6Code/SAFE: Investment account identification is not recognized or is invalid.
TaxExemptReason3Code/403B: 403(b). Account is a tax-deferred investment and savings program for employees of hospitals, educational institutions and other non-profit organizations, to save and invest in their own retirement. The name refers to the relevant section in the US Internal Revenue Code (required for US).
TaxExemptReason3Code/REFU: Account is for a refugee or person without a number assigned by a government organization, for example, without a Danish Central Securities Number.
